title: Сокращаем описание последовательности
description: Сокращаем описание последовательности: разбираем конструкцию и её смысл на примерах, в диалоге и авторском тексте без аудирования.
objectives: Выражать предшествующее действие через having done
Соотносить исполнитель начального оборота с подлежащим
notes: Having + причастие может показать завершённое действие перед основным: Having checked the figures, she sent the report.
Подразумеваемый исполнитель начального оборота должен совпадать с подлежащим основной части.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: ___ the figures, the analyst sent the revised report.
exercises.explanation: Having checked обозначает проверку, завершённую до отправки.

exercises.prompt: Вставь подходящее слово из пары: received / receiving.

public_payload.sentence: Having ___ approval, the group began the trial.

exercises.editorial_answer: Having received approval, the group began the trial.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Пересмотрев черновик, редактор отправил его обратно.»
exercises.editorial_answer: Having revised the draft, the editor sent it back.
exercises.explanation: Исполнитель обоих действий — the editor; пересмотр предшествует отправке.

exercises.prompt: Исправь только ошибку в конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: Having checked the room, the missing key was found by Anna.

accepted: Having checked the room, Anna found the missing key.

exercises.reference_answer: Having checked the room, Anna found the missing key.
exercises.incorrect_answer: Having checked the room, the missing key was found by Anna.
exercises.editorial_answer: Having checked the room, Anna found the missing key.
exercises.explanation: Начальный оборот относится к Anna, поэтому она должна быть подлежащим основной части.

exercises.prompt: Что координатор сделала после сбора предложений?

public_payload.passage: A volunteer group prepared a grant application for a community garden. Having collected residents’ suggestions, the coordinator revised the original budget. She removed a decorative gate and added more accessible planting beds. The group then submitted the application. Receiving acknowledgement of the application did not mean that funding had been approved: the committee would assess all proposals the following month. The coordinator told residents that preparations were complete, while the decision about money remained outside the group’s control.

options.label: She stopped the application before submission.
She announced that funding was guaranteed.

exercises.explanation: Having collected ... задаёт предшествующее действие перед пересмотром бюджета.

public_payload.passage: A volunteer group prepared a grant application for a community garden. Having collected residents’ suggestions, the coordinator revised the original budget. She removed a decorative gate and added more accessible planting beds. The group then submitted the application. Receiving acknowledgement of the application did not mean that funding had been approved: the committee would assess all proposals the following month. The coordinator told residents that preparations were complete, while the decision about money remained outside the group’s control.

options.label: Only that the application had been received.
That the project had won funding.
That no other proposals would be considered.

exercises.editorial_answer: Only that the application had been received.
exercises.explanation: Acknowledgement отличается от approval; решение будет позже.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Which sentence clearly makes the same person do both actions?

options.label: Having read the proposal, the deadline expired.
Having read the proposal, Omar signed it.
Having read the proposal, the signature was added.

exercises.editorial_answer: Having read the proposal, Omar signed it.
exercises.explanation: В первом варианте читает и подписывает Omar; в остальных подлежащие не могут читать.

public_payload.sentence: The committee’s formal agreement to the plan would be its ___.

exercises.explanation: Approval означает одобрение; уведомление о получении его не заменяет.
